title: Common
description: Identifiers and value formats shared by every Lumio device interface.

Uuid.description: Lowercase UUID (Lumio row ids are UUIDv7).

ShortId.description: Manufacturer short id ({mid}): 3-8 lowercase letters or digits, assigned at signup, immutable after activation.

Serial.description: Unit serial number. It becomes the second half of the device id, so it must be 8-32 letters or digits.

Did.description: Device id: '{mid}-{serial}'. MQTT client id and certificate CN.

Semver.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release suffix.

ChannelName.description: Channel id within one device, e.g. 'switch_1', 'power'. 'device' is reserved for device-level events.

CodeName.description: Machine-readable code: lowercase snake_case. Manufacturer-specific codes start with 'x_'.

Envelope.description: Fields every device-to-cloud MQTT message carries.

ts.description: When the device produced the message (Unix ms, from SNTP).

seq.description: Monotonic counter per boot, starting at 0. The cloud drops a repeated (boot, seq) pair.

boot.description: Random id generated at each boot (8-32 letters/digits). Lets the cloud tell a reboot from a replay.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 error body returned by every HTTP API.

code.description: Stable error code (snake_case); clients act on it, never on the English title. Codes used by the device and manufacturer APIs: validation_failed, unauthenticated, forbidden, not_found, conflict, rate_limited, limit_reached, claim_token_invalid, device_already_owned, hw_type_not_approved, api_key_suspended, signature_invalid, firmware_signature_invalid, internal_error. New codes may be added; treat an unknown code like its HTTP status.
